population: Every original 120 Hz key: 1,524 crawl and 898 get-up frames. No selection, downsampling or filtering.
reference: Captured mapped joint edge directions; lengths are reconstructed with the supplied rig's unchanged local translations. Shared rigid branches fit unit directions jointly. Rank-one branches use minimum swing; leaves favor original world orientation.
permissions: 19 mapped local joint rotations, each at most 25 degrees from the original transferred pose. All translations and unmapped helper local transforms fixed. No root relocation, floor lift or gate relaxation.
screen: At every native key evaluate every target vertex, compare original/proposed direction residuals, verify rotation caps/root/length/local preservation, and roundtrip the appended glTF animation. Preserve every proposed pose even when worse.
temporal_diagnostic: Compare every neighboring native-key local rotation speed with the original. Report maximum, p95, node and time; no new acceptance threshold or smoothing.
contact_policy: No captured support annotations exist; contacts remain unknown. This direction proposal is not contact correction.
scope: Feasible rig geometry does not establish temporal quality, source semantics, anatomical plausibility, between-key safety, dynamics, engine success or human approval.
